GitHub's compare of v0.1.78-a116616 and v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (222 files, complete) touches no Spinner file, no skeleton file (useReducedMotion lives there), no design-tokens or resolver file and no react-utils. Installed Spinner.tsx matches every guide and evidence sentence used here, read from source, not run, with token values through the package's own getVariableByName: size 72, durationMs 1500, gravity 0.45 (clamped 0–0.9), animating true and accessibilityLabel “Loading” by default (lines 178–188, 63–66, 196); stroke max(1, size × 12.8 / 72), so 12.8 at 72 and 5.69 at 32 (70, 197); three 100° arcs with round caps, no fill and no track (72, 117–128, 259–266); the lead angle is tau + gravity × sin(tau), fastest at the top and slowest at the bottom (152–155); the gap between heads breathes from 10° to 84° (75, 79, 163–170); the leading arc (primary) is drawn last, on top (253); resting is a fixed fan at 0°, −120° and −240°, not a frame of the spin (237, 254–256), shown when animating is false or the device asks for reduced motion (192–193; useReducedMotion reads prefers-reduced-motion on the web and AccessibilityInfo on native); the root is a size × size View with role progressbar and the label, and no pressable, focus or disabled handling (239–250); the three colours are spiner/primary, secondary and tertiary/bg, literals in the one-mode collection Spinner / Output, which resolve to rgb(208,162,89), rgb(91,0,181) and rgb(6,107,153) with no modes, with Color Mode Dark, with AppearanceBrand Secondary and with Semantic Intent System; colors replaces any of them (202–206). No guide sentence used here is contradicted. Gravity: Marcin's 12 October comment on #73 (“what is weight? Whatever it is do not work on the documentation page”) was about the playground's old Weight segment; the evidence's 13 October review found it a docs mistake, and 10b3720 removed the control and made Configuration name gravity and its value on each card. The entry records gravity as the package fact (its JSDoc, with the evidence's clamp) and the guide's own Configuration sentence on what it does, plus the Default card's values. The Heavy (0.85, 2.8 s) and Weightless (0, 1.6 s) cards are left out of configuration: they show values side by side, and no guide sentence says when to choose one, so they don't become advice; the playground (Size, Turn, Animating) is not part of the copy. Not recorded: style (the building rules keep style overrides off Coin components), testID and other inherited View props; Figma's variable names and hex values, the Storybook story list and args, the Reanimated stand-in on the docs site, and the measured speed ratios from the 13 October review; Button's loading drawing a Skeleton, not a Spinner (no guide sentence covers it). Skeleton: the summary keeps the Spinner for when the shape of what's loading can't be shown, but the guide never names Skeleton, so avoidWhen names no component (useInstead) for that case; the Skeleton entry's own guide doesn't mention Spinner either. Anatomy: all three arcs are always drawn. Content good keeps the guide's line “Fetching your statements…”; there is no bad copy (the Don't shows a spinner with no line). Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every component), and no Slot gap on the VStacks (the guide's S repeats VStack's default, and its M in In context changes only the look, which no guide sentence says the content needs). Text takes text, as its undocumented entry does. The In context example draws the loading state of the guide's screen with Title, the Spinner and its line in place of the list, and the Refresh Button, which the guide's own example turns off while loading (disabled={loading}); the literal disabled and the empty onPress stand for the screen's state and its wiring. The guide's ScreenFrame is a docs frame, not a Coin component, and is left out. All components used have an entry in this pack. Left out of examples (three at most): the sizing trio, the Default, Heavy and Weightless cards, the resting specimen, the Spin every row Don't and the playground. Gaps: the Sources note's stale Storybook; on 29 October the published Storybook (index.json last modified 17 October 2026) still lists the six stories, its docs page still has the old generated headings (Example, Available Collections and Modes, Usage, Sizes, Weight, Custom colours, Resting state, Props, Design Tokens), and its bundled Spinner still draws 0.11 × size and documents durationMs as 2400, so it predates a116616; the gap keeps the guide's words and this check is recorded here only. And the evidence's Figma discrepancy: Figma's one static pose is not the code's resting fan. Sorting (batch 10, rounds 1 and 2): two cross-check runs. Round 1 flagged /useWhen/2, which turned the In context refresh of statements into a recommendation for refreshing any list (generalises-example): our misreading, removed; the In context stays as the first example, and a general rule would also clash with Skeleton's entry, whose guide uses its own refresh pattern. Round 1 also flagged /examples/0 (the 40 px size and the disabled Refresh are not in the copy). Round 2, on the final entry, flagged /examples/0 again; it is dismissed in reviews/spinner.json, because both come from the guide's own In context code (spinner.guide.tsx lines 102 and 107 at 622cd82), which the reviewer can't see. Its notes, not flags: the core principle sits in useWhen (kept, as in Skeleton's entry); examples/1 puts the line under the spinner where the Content copy says next to it (the guide's own Waiting composition stacks it under, centred); and durationMs looked missing from the facts (types facts aren't shown to the reviewer; it is /facts/props/2). No trace-check flags remain.
